spans.s: Śāṇḍilī^1, a goddess. § 116 (Vasu): I, 66, 2584 (wife of Prajāpati and mother of the Vasu Anala).--§ 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 8, 295 (tatra--i.e. on the Śṛṅgavat mountain--svayamprabhā devī nityaṃ vasati Śºī).

Śāṇḍilī^2, a brāhmaṇī. § 565 (Gālavacarita): V, 113, 3872 (brāhmaṇī, performed austerities on the Ṛshabha mountain), 3890.--§ 764 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 123, 5859, 5864 (had attained to heaven, discourse between her and Sumanā).
